annotations.title: EU funding call deadline and status changes

description: Changes to open and forthcoming EU funding opportunities on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal (Horizon Europe, Digital Europe, CEF, LIFE, CERV and more): new calls, moved or added deadlines, status changes (forthcoming, open) and calls that closed or were withdrawn, each with the record before and after and a link to the official topic page. Pass next_cursor back as cursor to page or to poll. The portal is authoritative. Free.

identifier.description: Topic or call identifier, or its start, e.g. HORIZON-CL5-2026

since.description: Changes observed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago)
